messages:
sophie-logistics: FYI AWB 770-9988123 (H100 batch) is stuck at FRA broker. Carrier says their EDI gateway dropped packets and the manifest was NACKed. ETA for manual broker clearance ~20-26h. Need triage: hold for depot inspection or air-split priority units.
global-forwarder: Apologies. Our partner EDI gateway experienced intermittent timeouts, causing manifest rejections at the broker. We're clearing the backlog; manual broker review adds ~20h.
sophie-logistics: Any missing customs paperwork? last time COO mismatch caused 8h delay.
global-forwarder: Paperwork complete, but customs flagged a thermal sample inspection on 7 units. Depot requires photos + serial reconciliation before release.
ben-procurement: If hold >24h we should consider air-splitting 7 priority H100s FRA->AMS overnight. Ballpark uplift?
global-forwarder: Estimate ~€86k for 7 units next-day to AMS including uplift and brokerage. Can split AWBs but need decision by EOD CET to secure freighter space.
tara-ops: Which commitments are at risk? Arthur, how bad if those 7 are delayed 24-48h?
arthur-sre: Those 7 backfill two EU-west Dedicated pools and a hotfix rollout. A 48h delay would raise queue latency ~28% during peak and push one enterprise install. Canary mitigations reduce impact but not eliminate SLA exposure.
sophie-logistics: We must avoid duplicate RMAs if we split. Last quarter we got two separate RMA numbers for the same serials and warranty got messy.
global-forwarder: Understood. Warranty and RMA follow serials. We'll attach one RMA reference to any split AWB. Depot photos + signed manifest will kick the RMA flow.
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-3307 linked to AWB 770-9988123. Status: awaiting depot photos and signed attestation.
sophie-logistics: Uploading serials and photo checklist to the RMA now. Example serials:
```
serials: [H100-PQ2001,H100-PQ2002,H100-PQ2003,H100-PQ2004,H100-PQ2005,H100-PQ2006,H100-PQ2007,H100-PQ2008,H100-PQ2009,H100-PQ2010]
```
ben-procurement: I'll queue the €86k uplift for expedited approval. If finance declines, we accept a 24h hold and Arthur will trigger canary scaling.
arthur-sre: Canary scaling ready. I'll pre-warm smaller instance tiers, bump autoscale thresholds, and flip KV-cache routing for non-critical traffic. Policy flip ETA ~12m. If hold extends past 36h, push for air-split.
sophie-logistics: Global-forwarder — if the EDI outage is on your partner side, can you request a surcharge credit for expedited uplift? We prefer not to absorb the full cost if delay was your partner's fault.
global-forwarder: Escalated. Partner has acknowledged partial outage on their EDI gateway and opened a surcharge dispute. They'll request a partial credit; can't guarantee. Will update in ~3h.
tara-ops: Legal note: require signed depot attestation that photos are admissible for insurance/RMA claims. Add explicit language to RMA notes.
sophie-logistics: Added legal clause to RMA-3307. If waiver denied we execute air-split by 18:30 CET. @global-forwarder please prioritize depot photos + signed manifest and confirm whether RMA chain remains singular for split AWBs. :thumbsup:
global-forwarder: Prioritizing. Confirmed: single RMA per serial across split AWBs, and we'll attach signed manifest to RMA-3307 once depot completes inspection. Update by 17:30 CET.
